head: Spotify cache limit: new setting caps how much storage it uses
dek: Spotify's help page now lists a Cache limit slider in its phone and tablet apps, so you can set how much space temporary playback files take. Downloaded songs and podcasts aren't part of the cache.
details: The slider is under your profile picture, Settings and privacy, Data-saving and offline, Storage, Cache limit; pick a limit and tap Set limit, or Reset to go back to Spotify's automatic setting. Spotify warns that a smaller limit may affect playback and use more data, and the cache can go over the limit for a while before its regular cleanup. In September, Android Authority found the setting in the Android app's code, as Digital Trends reported then, and noted that downloads are stored separately.
where: Spotify's phone and tablet apps (not desktop); may not show on every phone yet
means: If Spotify fills your phone's storage, you can now cap its cache instead of clearing it again and again.
todo: Open the setting at Settings and privacy, Data-saving and offline, Storage, Cache limit. If it isn't there yet, update the app, or use Clear cache in the same place.
